ios.note: These screens use demo data. Your forecast and daily spending limit update with your own budget, spending, and upcoming costs.

steps.title: Find Budget Health on Home
steps.text: The daily spending tile gives you an amount to aim for each remaining day. Below it, the two tiles show what is left today and where spending is projected to finish.
steps.alt: Vylo Home with $950 left, $3.18K projected spending, and a $72 daily limit.
steps.caption: Vylo for iPhone · Demo data

steps.title: Open the forecast
steps.text: Tap the Projected Spend tile on Home or Budget. The breakdown shows spending so far, flexible spend pace, upcoming recurring costs, and the comparison with your budget.
steps.alt: Projected Spend breakdown: $2,200 spent, $680 flexible pace, $300 upcoming, and $3,180 projected against a $3,150 budget.
steps.caption: Vylo for iPhone · Demo data

steps.title: Check upcoming recurring costs
steps.text: Expand Upcoming Recurring Costs. If you do not expect a listed payment, tap Ignore beside it. In this example, we ignore the $90 Internet cost. This changes the forecast; it does not cancel the service.
steps.alt: Expanded upcoming costs with Internet $90, Car insurance $180, and Subscriptions $30, each with an Ignore action.
steps.caption: Vylo for iPhone · Demo data

steps.title: See your updated daily limit
steps.text: Close the breakdown to return to Home. The forecast is now $3,090, or $60 under budget, and the daily limit is $82. Left to spend stays at $950 because no actual spending changed.
steps.alt: Updated Budget Health showing $950 left, $3.09K projected, $60 under budget, and $82 per day to stay on track.
steps.caption: Vylo for iPhone · Demo data
